goal: 20 more v2 high-quality One Life Relay stages (batch C)

stages.title: 달구지
stages.description: 짐이 기울지 않게 달구지를 몰아 장터까지 가세요.
stages.mechanic: Third-person cart on a dirt road. Cargo shifts with turns. Slow on bumps. Distinct from gyro-keep. Camera behind the ox.

stages.title: 이끼 등반
stages.description: 미끄러운 이끼 벽을 타이밍에 맞춰 오르세요.
stages.mechanic: Hold points appear on a wet cliff. Tap while the grip is green. Wet holds telegraph then slip. Distinct from chimney-brush and pulley-cliff. Camera on the face.

stages.title: 맷돌
stages.description: 맷돌 속도에 맞춰 곡식을 넣어 가루를 내세요.
stages.mechanic: Close-up rotating millstones. Feed when the eye is open. Overfeed jams, starve empties. Distinct from mill-wheel (no water buckets). Camera on the stones.

stages.title: 횃불 계주
stages.description: 바람이 꺼뜨리기 전에 횃불을 다음 봉화까지 옮기세요.
stages.mechanic: Run ridge to ridge. Gusts threaten the flame; hold to shield (slows). Light unlit beacons. Distinct from smoke-beacon (no Morse) and wind-lantern (relay, not shrine escort). Camera behind.

stages.title: 과수원 흔들기
stages.description: 나무를 흔들어 익은 과일만 바구니에 받으세요.
stages.mechanic: Shake a tree; ripe fruit falls first, green later if over-shaken. Catch with a basket. Distinct from tessera-fall. Orchard camera.

stages.title: 봉인 돌
stages.description: 회전하는 석판을 맞춰 무덤 문을 봉인하세요.
stages.mechanic: Three concentric tomb discs. Align glyphs. Misalign too long overloads. Distinct from ley-compass (glyphs not ley lines). Camera on the door.

stages.title: 통 구르기
stages.description: 언덕 아래 창고까지 통을 깨지지 않게 굴리세요.
stages.mechanic: Barrel auto-rolls downhill. Steer around rocks. Speed cracks it. Distinct from scarab-roll (downhill guide not uphill push) and atlas-sphere. Camera behind.

stages.title: 채석 블록
stages.description: 크레인으로 석재를 내려 자리에 안착시키세요.
stages.mechanic: Overhead crane in a quarry. Lower blocks onto footprints. Too fast shatters. Distinct from polar-crane (no polarity). Top-down 3D pit.

stages.title: 향 코일
stages.description: 향 연기가 나선 길을 따라가게 바람을 막으세요.
stages.mechanic: Smoke follows a spiral groove. Drafts blow it off; fan to block drafts. Distinct from smoke-beacon. Close shrine camera.

stages.title: 염소 암벽
stages.description: 좁은 바위 턱을 건너 염소를 우리로 이끄세요.
stages.mechanic: Mountain goats follow a lure. Ledges crumble. Distinct from koi-gate and constellation-herd. Side-3/4 cliff camera.

stages.title: 도화선
stages.description: 불씨가 갈림길에서 올바른 선으로 가게 꺾으세요.
stages.mechanic: Spark travels a fuse. Upcoming forks highlight. Tap to switch before the spark arrives. Distinct from fuse-connect (routing not wiring). Mine camera chase.

stages.title: 새둥지
stages.description: 바람에 날아가는 나뭇가지를 받아 둥지를 엮으세요.
stages.mechanic: Twigs blow past a cliff nest. Catch matching lengths. Distinct from comet-net. Camera at the nest.

stages.title: 달 웅덩이
stages.description: 물결을 맞춰 달 그림자를 웅덩이 중심에 모으세요.
stages.mechanic: Tap to send ripples. Intersect them under the moon reflection. Too many ripples flood. Distinct from ripple-guide if 2D. Night pool camera.

stages.title: 성에 창
stages.description: 성에를 손가락으로 닦아 문양을 드러내세요.
stages.mechanic: Frosted window. Trace the ghost pattern. Press too hard cracks glass. Distinct from ice-sculptor. Close window camera.

stages.title: 외바퀴 수레
stages.description: 벽돌을 싣고 외바퀴 수레로 비계까지 가세요.
stages.mechanic: Balance a wheelbarrow on a plank. Distinct from ox-cart (one wheel, hold-to-roll). Construction camera behind.

stages.title: 북가죽
stages.description: 가죽을 팽팽하게 당겨 북 음을 맞추세요.
stages.mechanic: Tighten lugs around a drum. Tap to hear pitch vs target. Over-tighten tears. Distinct from drum-geyser and bellows-heart. Close drum camera.

stages.title: 등잔 기름
stages.description: 흔들리는 배에서 등잔에 기름을 따르세요.
stages.mechanic: Ship cabin pitches. Pour oil into lantern reservoirs. Distinct from resin-catch and potion-pour. Cabin camera.

stages.title: 수조 담금
stages.description: 달군 쇠를 알맞은 순간에 물에 담그세요.
stages.mechanic: NOT forge-strike (no hammer color window). Lower glowing iron into a trough when steam cue hits. Early/late warps. Close quench camera.

stages.title: 벌집 채밀
stages.description: 벌을 깨우지 않게 꿀방을 잘라 내세요.
stages.mechanic: Cut comb cells. Bees patrol; pause when they look. Distinct from bee-garden and pollen-lane. Close hive camera.

stages.title: 밀물 계단
stages.description: 밀물에 잠기기 전에 돌계단을 오르세요.
stages.mechanic: Stone stairs up a sea stack. Tide rises from below. Distinct from hourglass-climb (water not sand) and spiral-ascent (no rotating helix). Camera behind looking up.
